_baseDir_note: relative paths of local models (upstreams.*.start) resolve against baseDir, relative to this folder; here the ChatSOP repository root

plan.note: owner, 2026-10-02: 15/rpm; 400 requests every 5 hours; 7,500 requests per week (subscription 15 USD). A 'request' is a credit unit: each call costs its model's quota_multiplier (x-quota-cost), e.g. Qwen3.8 27b 0.1, GLM-5.3-Flash 1. maxPerMinute 15 and maxPerHour 800 stay as queue limits.

openrouter._note: pay-as-you-go credit; cost per call is OpenRouter's usage.cost (USD). Route: /u/openrouter/v1/...

deepseek._note: official DeepSeek API, paid; key not configured yet. Route: /u/deepseek/v1/...

local._note: local Qwen3-4B, always on (owner 2026-10-02: enough memory, fast enough): started when the proxy starts and restarted on demand; GPU reservation lock files still block a start. Route /u/local/... or tier tiny. Owner 2026-10-03: throughput over latency: 32 parallel slots (measured ~24 short requests/s aggregate vs ~13 at 4 slots).

smallmodels._note: owner 2026-10-03: the small non-chat models of the formalization architecture, a managed local service like the llama-server of tiny: started with the proxy (startAtBoot) and restarted on demand; clients see only the tiers structure and formalizer. local-services/small-models/ (onnxruntime-node, CPU only: no CUDA provider on linux-arm64; 4 intra-op threads per model): GLiNER2.5 base (PSM, POST /v1/structure) and T5-base NL-to-FOL (LFM, POST /v1/fol). JSON endpoints, not chat.

fallback._note: owner 2026-10-02: when openference is unavailable (unreachable or 5xx after retry.max5xx retries, 429 after retry.max retries or with retry-after above maxWaitMs, or a queue/plan-gate wait above maxWaitMs) a request for a mapped model goes to this upstream and model. Response header x-llmapiprovider-fallback; opt out per request with x-llmapiprovider-no-fallback: 1.

compare._note: USD per 1M tokens. DeepSeek official prices from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (read 2026-10-02): deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) cache hit 0.006/0.003, cache miss 0.30/0.15, output 1.20/0.60 at peak/off-peak (off-peak is half; peak 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays). Re-check before deciding.

tiers._note: owner 2026-10-02: clients and jobs name a tier, never a concrete model. A tier is a chain of {upstream, model}; the first usable entry serves, the rest is its fallback. best is unconfigured (pro models via OpenRouter later): a request for it is an error. equivalence (owner 2026-10-03): a very small, fast model that only decides whether two short answers are equivalent (A implies B and B implies A); today the local Qwen3-4B, no fallback; used only after deterministic normalization fails. structure and formalizer (owner 2026-10-03): the PSM (GLiNER2.5 base, POST /v1/structure) and the LFM (T5-base NL-to-FOL, POST /v1/fol) on the local small-model service; JSON endpoints, not chat; no fallback. Owner 2026-10-03: the backends of structure and formalizer are swappable: structure and formalizer name one of the variant tiers below; a variant with `prompt` is a chat model with a role prompt (prompts/<name>.md, LLMAPIProvider/prompted.mjs) under the same JSON contract: structure-gliner (GLiNER2.5), structure-tiny (Qwen3-4B + psm-v1), formalizer-t5 (T5-base), formalizer-t5-3b (T5-3B), formalizer-tiny (Qwen3-4B + fol-v1), formalizer-llama-fol (Llama-3.2-1B NL2FOL + fol-plain-v1).

audit._note: request/response pairs of the cheap tiers, for the periodic medium-tier review in batch work; chat traffic is only logged. Dir: ~/.local/share/llmapiprovider-audit/

jobs._note: owner 2026-10-02: LLM batch work runs as registered jobs (tools/llm-jobs) with a budget per run; requests carry x-llmapiprovider-purpose. Allowed purposes pass; any other request (no purpose or an unknown one) counts against a small daily allowance and is refused beyond it (403 untagged_limit). A registered run is refused at its budget (402 budget_exceeded) and after it finished (403 run_finished).

interactive._note: owner 2026-10-02: a person waiting (chat turn, formalization, answer wording) goes first in every upstream queue and falls back down its tier chain after maxWaitMs instead of queueing behind batch jobs

cache._note: owner 2026-10-02: responses are cached by default (the same request gets the same answer; the reasoner reacts to context changes, the formalization need not vary). Key = the whole request body + target tier/upstream + model identity (local GGUF size and mtime). Header x-llmapiprovider-cache: off | use | strict (a miss is refused, for regressions) | record. Only complete non-streamed 200 answers from the tier's first model are stored. Dir ~/.local/share/llmapiprovider-cache/.
